library_preparation_preflight.summary: The artifact's POM marks spring-ai-model and spring-boot-autoconfigure as optional, so they are not on the test classpath transitively. The tests need them added explicitly, plus spring-boot-test for ApplicationContextRunner. No Docker image is needed because the default chat memory repository is in-memory.

deterministic_setup.reason: Optional dependency of the autoconfigure artifact. It provides ChatMemory, ChatMemoryRepository and MessageWindowChatMemory, which the autoconfiguration wires.

library_preparation_preflight.agent_guidance: Use ApplicationContextRunner with AutoConfigurations.of(ChatMemoryAutoConfiguration.class) and no external services. Exercise the default in-memory ChatMemoryRepository and MessageWindowChatMemory, and the spring.ai.chat.memory.* properties binding (ChatMemoryProperties). Also test the @ConditionalOnMissingBean back-off with a user-supplied ChatMemoryRepository. Model the build.gradle on tests/src/org.springframework.ai/spring-ai-autoconfigure-model-chat-client: conditional agent mode with user-code-filter.json. Do not add JDBC, Cassandra, Mongo or Neo4j repository modules. They are separate artifacts that need databases. No system properties or environment variables are required.
